name: cove-mcp
description: The first CLI and MCP server for Cove Data Protection: fleet-wide backup health, billing usage, and storage trends from your terminal, with the local history the vendor console doesn't keep.

cove_username.title: COVE_USERNAME
cove_username.description: Backup.management user with API access enabled (Security Officer + API flag; a service account, not an interactive-2FA login). Exchanged via the Cove JSON-RPC Login method for a cached session visa.

cove_password.title: COVE_PASSWORD
cove_password.description: Password for COVE_USERNAME. Exchanged once for a cached session visa; never written to disk beyond the local visa cache, never logged.

cove_partner.title: COVE_PARTNER
cove_partner.description: Optional partner name to scope queries to a specific reseller or customer level. Defaults to the partner resolved from the login.

cove_base_url.title: COVE_BASE_URL
cove_base_url.description: Optional override for the Cove JSON-RPC endpoint. Defaults to the standard backup.management API host; set only for a regional or mock endpoint.
